properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 5 at 8:47PM CDT until October 6 at 9:45PM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Missouri...

Missouri River at Boonville affecting Howard, Cooper, Moniteau and
Boone Counties.

Missouri River At Miami affecting Chariton, Carroll and Saline
Counties.

Missouri River at Waverly affecting Saline, Carroll and Lafayette
Counties.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Missouri...

Missouri River at Glasgow affecting Chariton, Howard and Saline
Counties.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Missouri River at Boonville.

* WHEN...Until Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 21.0 feet, Low-lying rural areas along the river
flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:04 PM CDT Monday the stage was 21.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
this evening and continue falling to 10.8 feet Saturday evening.
- Flood stage is 21.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

This product along with additional weather and stream information is
available at www.weather.gov/kc/.

properties.areaDesc: Baker, FL; Nassau, FL; Charlton, GA
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 5 at 9:44PM EDT until October 8 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in northeast
Florida and southeast Georgia...

St Mary's River At Macclenny affecting Charlton, Nassau and Baker
Counties.

Additional information is available at
https://water.weather.gov/wfo/JAX

The next statement will be issued Tuesday evening at 945 PM EDT.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Mary's River at Macclenny.

* WHEN...Until Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Minor flooding of low lying areas and
timber lands including some properties along St. Mary's River Bluff
Road and the Cypress Landing Resort on the Georgia side. At 14.0
feet, Flooding of bottomlands along the river and some lower access
roads including the lower half of St. Mary's River Bluff Road which
cuts off 15 to 20 homes on the Georgia side.


* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:45 PM EDT Monday the stage was 12.7 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 13.0 feet
tomorrow evening. It will then fall below flood stage Thursday
evening.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.areaDesc: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
properties.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 5 at 6:39PM PDT until October 9 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, dangerous rip currents
expected. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal
flooding expected.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, from Tuesday afternoon
through Friday evening. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 6
AM Wednesday to 11 AM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only isolated
road closures expected. Minor coastal erosion is also expected.
Additionally, elevated surf will lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 3-6 feet, with sets to 7
feet, on south and southwest-facing beaches. High tides are
expected to peak between 6.5 and 7.0 feet during the mornings
and evenings.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

properties.areaDesc: Port Austin to Harbor Beach MI
properties.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 9:32PM EDT until October 7 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Detroit/Pontiac MI
properties.description:
* WHAT...Expect sustained winds up to 20 knots from the
southwest with gusts up to 28 knots. The largest significant
waves will be 3 feet with a potential maximum wave height of 5
feet.

* WHERE...Port Austin to Harbor Beach MI.

* WHEN...The maximum winds are expected around 12 AM EDT
Wednesday with the largest waves expected around 4 AM EDT
Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
properties.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
